  • Tatiyavagga Chapter Three

Musāvādasutta Lying

Vuttañhetaṁ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṁ: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.

“Ekadhammaṁ atītassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa nāhaṁ tassa kiñci pāpakammaṁ akaraṇīyanti vadāmi. “Mendicants, for an individual person who transgresses in one thing, there is no bad deed they would not do, I say. Katamaṁ ekadhammaṁ? What one thing? Yadidaṁ, bhikkhave, sampajānamusāvādo”ti. It is this: telling a deliberate lie.”

Etamatthaṁ bhagavā avoca. The Buddha spoke this matter. Tatthetaṁ iti vuccati: On this it is said:

“Ekadhammaṁ atītassa, “When a personage, spurning the hereafter, musāvādissa jantuno; transgresses in just one thing— Vitiṇṇaparalokassa, lying— natthi pāpaṁ akāriyan”ti. there is no evil they would not do.”

Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti. This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.

Pañcamaṁ.
